mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate, as measured by the FEDFUNDS series, compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 12 months is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is negative.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery periods, characterized by declining unemployment and positive GDP growth, the S&P 500 tends to exhibit positive forward returns as economic activity expands and corporate profits improve.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 7.0 and GDPC1 > 0.0, the S&P 500 fails to produce positive 60d returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1000 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand for housing and associated sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1000.0 fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to correlate with positive 60d returns (Rank IC < 0.02) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and stock prices, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST increases fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 50% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 7.0%, it indicates a tight labor market that supports wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 7.0 fails to produce positive 5d returns in > 55% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.
